description.value: The Boathouse has been a waterfront dining institution since 1981, specializing in fresh sustainable seafood, Ocean Wise-certified selections, premium steaks, and one of the largest BC VQA wine selections in the region. Situated along the scenic Fraser River at New West Quay, the restaurant offers a stylish indoor dining room and bar alongside a seasonal open-air patio overlooking the water and riverboats. It is one of two Lower Mainland locations and serves as a prominent destination along the riverside cycling corridors of New Westminster.
